task: Answer whether the supplied queue can guarantee globally ordered processing under the proposed deployment. Use only the provided excerpts; no browsing or runtime tools are available.

Version-3 tutorial excerpt: "Our one-partition, one-consumer example processes messages in order." Version-4 retry note: "A delayed retry does not stop later messages from being delivered." A team slide says "the queue is FIFO" without a version or definition.
expected: Rejects an unconditional global processing-order guarantee for the proposed deployment.
Separates partition enqueue order, delivery, completion, and retry behavior.
Uses the version-4 scoped guarantees over the version-3 example and unsupported slide, while stating the no-live-verification limitation.

evidence: Claim-by-claim attribution to the supplied excerpts and explicit applicability conditions.
